newsitem.title: USA: Litton says Ratcliffe has counsel.
newsitem.headline: Litton says Ratcliffe has counsel.

text.p: A Litton Industries Inc spokesman said an executive, Donald Ratcliffe, who was arrested in South Korea for alleged spying has retained a lawyer.
"We understand he is represented by counsel in-country," said a Litton spokesman, adding Litton was cooperating with authorities and doing everything it can to support Ratcliffe.
The spokesman said "We aren't aware of any wrongdoing."
Ratcliffe, 62, was arrested Wednesday by the Agency for National Security Planning on suspicion of collecting military secrets.
South Korea plans to buy arms and military equipment worth billions of dollars by the early 21st century to modernize its defenses.
The United States, to which Seoul has looked as a main supplier of military hardware, is now competing with European and Russian suppliers to win more of the planned arms supply contracts.
